props.text: A 2026 deep-dive on Aeon's exit taxonomy — the architectural answer to AI-driven notification fatigue. With 80% of enterprise apps embedding copilots by year-end and on-call teams already drowning in alerts, the agents that scale are the ones whose skills end in named exits (OK, SKIP_UNCHANGED, NEW_INFO, ERROR…) and whose default mode is silent. ~100 skill runs a day on this project; 4–8 notifications. The decision to *not* notify happens inside the skill, before any router sees it.

props.title: Why a Healthy AI Agent Has Three Different Words for "Nothing Happened"
